dedupe_keys.name: moody s rms catastrophe models and modelling platform

description: Moody's catastrophe modelling offering, built on the former RMS models, is used by insurers, reinsurers, financial institutions, corporations and public agencies to evaluate natural and man-made catastrophe risk, from earthquakes and hurricanes to floods and wildfires. The page states more than 400 models in nearly 100 countries, with model documentation, and a cloud-native platform that integrates more than 700 models from various vendors into one environment, used to estimate the likelihood and severity of future disasters and simulate portfolio losses. Access is commercial: the page offers contact with sales specialists and no public download. Caveats: models, vulnerability curves and exposure databases are proprietary, results depend on licensed model versions, and portfolio loss estimates are designed for insurance, not engineering design. For infrastructure studies it is the reference commercial source of probabilistic multi-hazard loss and fragility modelling that insurers use for utilities, transport and buildings; related open records are the GEM fragility compendium and the FEMA National Risk Index.
